description: EPA fuel economy for every version of a vehicle by year, make and model: city, highway and combined MPG (MPGe, kWh per 100 miles and range for an EV; gas MPG, electric MPGe and electric range for a plug-in hybrid), EPA annual fuel cost, 5-year savings against the average new car, tailpipe CO2, EPA fuel economy and greenhouse gas scores, and the average MPG real drivers report on fueleconomy.gov when there is one.

make.description: Manufacturer, e.g. Toyota, Ford, Tesla, Chevrolet (Chevy and VW work too).

model.description: Model name as people say it, e.g. "RAV4", "F-150", "Model Y", "Camry hybrid", "CR-V AWD".

trim.description: Optional words to narrow it: hybrid, plug-in, AWD, 4WD, FWD, diesel, a trim (XLE, Limited) or an engine (2.7, turbo).

year.description: Model year, e.g. 2026. Default: the newest model year that lists this vehicle.

name: fuel_economy_lookup
title: Fuel economy and MPG lookup
